title: Midnight Reef Esports — Series A
audience: gaming-focused VC partners evaluating a competitive esports org
core_points: Org thesis: esports spend the next decade re-verticalizing — regional orgs beat global brands
Our five-game roster built around SEA+ANZ timezone: Valorant, League, Dota 2, Apex, Smash
Champion hardware: 7 top-32 placements across 3 games in 2025
Audience footprint: 2.1M monthly unique viewers across Twitch + YouTube, 58% 18-24
Sponsor mix: 4 anchor brands locked, $3.4M committed for 2026, 2 renewals already signed
Content arm: weekly team-media series, 140K avg views per episode, brand-safe and creator-led
Facility: dedicated 4,200 sqft bootcamp in Auckland with practice rooms, studio, PT/physio
Player pipeline: academy program with 18 under-20 players; two have already promoted to starting roster
Unit economics: $220K avg revenue per team, $140K avg cost per team, profitable at top-2-game focus
Risk and mitigation: game-title risk (hedged via 5-game portfolio), talent retention (equity + tenure bonuses)
Series A ask: $18M at $72M post, 18-month runway to double sponsor roster and expand to Korea
